Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
PICKING CONE AND BOLT FOR LOOMS

1. Scope — Prescribes requirements for picking cone and bolt for looms. 

2. Manufacture 

2.1 Material— Cones and bolts shall be made from the material as given below: 

a) Picking cone — Cast iron or any other suitable material as agreed to between the buyer and 

the seller. 

b) Picking bolt— Steel conforming to designation C40 of IS: 2073-1970 ' Carbon steel bars for 

production of machined parts for general engineering purposes \ 

2.2 Freedom from Defects — Picking cone shall be sound, clean and free from blow holes, hard 
spots and other harmful defects. 

2.3 Provision of Test Bars — In case of picking cone the test bars shall be cast separately for tensile 
strength. They shall be poured at the same time and from the same ladle of metal as the compo- 
nents they represent. 

3. Requirements 

3.1 Dimensions and Shape— As agreed between the buyer and the seller according to the make of 
loom subject to the tolerances specified in IS : 5519-1969 ' Deviations for untoleranced dimensions of 
grey iron castings' in respect of picking cone and IS: 2102-1969 'Allowable deviations for 
dimensions without specified tolerances {first revision ) ' in respect of picking bolt. 

3.1.1 Typical picking cone and bolt are shown in Fig. 1 and 2.

3.2.1 Picking cone — The tensile strength of test bars shall be carried out in accordance with 
IS : 2078-1962 ' Method for tensile testing of grey cast iron ' and shall meet the requirements given in 
Table 1.

3.2.2 Picking bolt — The minimum tensile strength ^and elongation of material of picking bolt 
determined according to IS : 1608-1972 ' Method for tensile testing of steel products (first revision y 
shall be 5687 MN/m 2 (58 kgf/mm 2 ) and 18 percent respectively measured on a gauge of 5'65 */A, 
' A ' being the original area of cross section. 

3.3 Hardness — The hardness of picking cone as measured on Rockwell C scale according to the 
method prescribed in IS : 1586-1968 ' Method for Rockwell hardness test (8 and C scales) for steef 
( first revision ) ' shall be not less than 30 HRC. 

4. Marking — Each component shall be legibly marked with the manufacturer's name or trade- 
mark. 

4.1 ISI Certification Marking — The components may also be marked with the ISI Certification Mark. 
Details of the scheme are available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

5. Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed to between the buyer and the seller, to ascertain the 
conformity of picking cone and bolt to the requirements of this specification single sampling plan 
with Inspection Level 1 and Acceptable Quality Level ( AQL) of 2'5 percent given in Tables 1 and 2 
of IS :2500 ( Part I )-1973 ' Sampling inspection tables: Part I Inspection by attributes and by count 
of defects ( first revision) ' shall be followed.
